  --scope TEXT    Free-text scope/intent instead of an exact name — broadcasts

  --from TEXT     Sender name shown to the recipient(s)
  --children      Deliver to every subordinate of --to (agents whose folder
                  sits under its folder) instead of to --to itself
  --deep          With --children: the whole subtree, not only direct
                  subordinates
  --friends       Deliver to every las-friend of --to (the `friends` list in

  --session TEXT  Only one of the recipient's connected sessions: a session
                  id, or a runtime (claude, claudeRelay, codex, shell).
                  Default: the last one used.
  --all-sessions  Every connected session of the recipient, one delivery each
                  (like --children, but across its runtimes).
  --cc            Also hand the recipient's last-used session a for-the-record
                  copy (kind cc) when the message goes to another session —
                  e.g. a command for its shell that its Claude should know
                  about.

    *   Monitorear el estado del backend y los agentes registrados (`las status`, `las agents`).

    *   `las attach`: Ejecutar comandos dentro de una sesión interactiva (nota: requiere argumentos válidos).
    *   `las claude`: Conectar terminales con Claude en el entorno LAS (`--account`, `--no-widget`).
    *   `las codex`: Conectar terminales con Codex (`--exec`, `--port`).
    *   `las speak`: Programar un mensaje para que sea hablado por un widget.
